```{r, echo=TRUE}
## ==========================================================
## TFCE for between-subject 2 x 2 factorial design in R
##
## Full model:
##   Amplitude ~ FactorA * FactorB
##
## Tests:
##   1. Factor A main effect
##   2. Factor B main effect
##   3. Factor A x Factor B interaction
##
## Permutation:
##
##   Factor A:
##     Permute FactorA within levels of FactorB.
##
##   Factor B:
##     Permute FactorB within levels of FactorA.
##
##   Interaction:
##     Obtain the interaction statistic from the same full
##     model fitted after permuting FactorB within FactorA.
##
## Synchronized permutation:
##   Subject-level design labels are permuted once during each
##   permutation and reused at every Channel x Time point.
## ==========================================================

rm(list = ls())

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(future)
library(future.apply)
library(progressr)
library(fields)

source("../R/tfce_transform.R")

cat("\nStarting TFCE 2 x 2 between-subject analysis...\n")

## ==========================================================
## -1. Load data
## ==========================================================

designTable <- read_csv("../data/03_designTable.csv")
EEGlong     <- read_csv("../data/03_EEGdata_long.csv")

print(names(designTable))
print(names(EEGlong))

## ==========================================================
## 0. Merge EEG data with design table
## ==========================================================

dat <- EEGlong %>%
  left_join(designTable, by = "Subject") %>%
  mutate(
    Subject     = factor(Subject),
    Channel     = factor(Channel),
    FactorA     = as.numeric(FactorA),
    FactorB     = as.numeric(FactorB)
  )

channels <- unique(EEGlong$Channel)
times    <- sort(unique(EEGlong$Time))

nChan <- length(channels)
nTime <- length(times)

## ==========================================================
## Basic checks
## ==========================================================
cell_sizes <- dat %>%
  count(FactorA, FactorB)

if (nrow(cell_sizes) != 4) {
  stop("Some FactorA ¡Á FactorB combinations are missing.")
}

if (length(unique(cell_sizes$n)) != 1) {

  print(cell_sizes)

  stop(
    "The experimental design is unbalanced. ",
    "All FactorA ¡Á FactorB cells must contain ",
    "the same number of subjects.",
    
    "IN THE CASE OF UNBALANCED DATA, PLEASE TURN TO TFCE04"
  )

}

cat("\nBalanced 2 ¡Á 2 design detected.\n")

## ==========================================================
## -2. Function: compute t-map for one effect
## ==========================================================

compute_tmap_2x2 <- function(data) {
  res <- data %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    group_modify( ~ {
      fit <- lm(Amplitude ~ FactorA * FactorB, data = .x)
      
      cf <- coef(summary(fit))
      
      tibble(t_A = cf["FactorA", "t value"],
             t_B = cf["FactorB", "t value"],
             t_Int = cf["FactorA:FactorB", "t value"])
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  make_matrix <- function(x) {
    tmat <- res %>%
      mutate(
        Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
        Time = factor(Time, levels = times)
      ) %>%
      arrange(Channel, Time) %>%
      pull(x)
    
    matrix(
      tmat,
      nrow = nChan,
      ncol = nTime,
      byrow = TRUE,
      dimnames = list(channels, times)
    )
  }
  
  list(A = make_matrix("t_A"),
       B = make_matrix("t_B"),
       Int = make_matrix("t_Int"))
}


## ==========================================================
## Step 1: Observed t-map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 1: Computing observed t-map...\n")

t_Obs <- compute_tmap_2x2(dat)

t_ObsA <- t_Obs$A
t_ObsB <- t_Obs$B
t_ObsInt <- t_Obs$Int

cat("Observed t-map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 2: Observed TFCE map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 2: Computing observed TFCE map...\n")

TFCE_ObsA <- tfce_transform(t_ObsA, E  = 0.66, H  = 2, dh = 0.1)

TFCE_ObsB <- tfce_transform(t_ObsB, E  = 0.66, H  = 2, dh = 0.1)

TFCE_ObsInt <- tfce_transform(t_ObsInt, E = 0.66, H = 2, dh = 0.1)

cat("Observed TFCE map completed.\n")

## ========================================================
## Step 3: Synchronized permutation test
##
## For Factor A:
##   permute FactorA within strata of FactorB
##
## For Factor B:
##   permute FactorB within strata of FactorA
##
## The Factor B and interaction statistics are extracted from
## the same permuted full factorial model
##
## The same subject-level permutation is reused for all
## Channel x Time points.
## ========================================================

set.seed(123)

nPerm <- 999
TFCE_permMaxA <- TFCE_permMaxB <- TFCE_permMaxInt <- rep(NA_real_, nPerm)

## ==========================================================
## Step 3: Synchronized permutation test
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 3: Starting synchronized permutation testing...\n")

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## Set up parallel processing
## ----------------------------------------------------------

n_workers <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)

plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)

handlers("txtprogressbar")

cat("Step 3: Starting synchronized permutation testing...\n")

with_progress({

  progress_update <- progressor(along = seq_len(nPerm))

  perm_results <- future_lapply(

    seq_len(nPerm),

    function(p){

      ## ----------------------------------------------------
      ## Factor A permutation
      ## ----------------------------------------------------

      perm_designA <- designTable %>%
        group_by(FactorB) %>%
        mutate(FactorA = sample(FactorA)) %>%
        ungroup()

      perm_datA <- EEGlong %>%
        left_join(perm_designA %>%
                    select(Subject, FactorA, FactorB), by = "Subject") %>%
        mutate(
          Subject = factor(Subject),
          Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
          FactorA = as.numeric(FactorA),
          FactorB = as.numeric(FactorB)
        )

      t_permA <- compute_tmap_2x2(perm_datA)

      TFCE_permA <- tfce_transform(t_permA$A,
                                   E = 0.66,
                                   H = 2,
                                   dh = 0.1)

      permMaxA <- max(abs(TFCE_permA), na.rm = TRUE)

      ## ----------------------------------------------------
      ## Factor B permutation
      ##
      ## Interaction is extracted from the same model
      ## ----------------------------------------------------

      perm_designB <- designTable %>%
        group_by(FactorA) %>%
        mutate(FactorB = sample(FactorB)) %>%
        ungroup()

      perm_datB <- EEGlong %>%
        left_join(perm_designB %>%
                    select(Subject, FactorA, FactorB), by = "Subject") %>%
        mutate(
          Subject = factor(Subject),
          Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
          FactorA = as.numeric(FactorA),
          FactorB = as.numeric(FactorB)
        )
      
      t_permB <- compute_tmap_2x2(perm_datB)

      TFCE_permB <- tfce_transform(t_permB$B,
                                   E = 0.66,
                                   H = 2,
                                   dh = 0.1)

      TFCE_permInt <- tfce_transform(t_permB$Int,
                                     E = 0.66,
                                     H = 2,
                                     dh = 0.1)

      permMaxB <- max(abs(TFCE_permB), na.rm = TRUE)

      permMaxInt <- max(abs(TFCE_permInt), na.rm = TRUE)

      progress_update()

      c(A = permMaxA, B = permMaxB, Int = permMaxInt)

    },

    future.seed = TRUE,

    future.packages = c("dplyr", "readr")

  )

})

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## Combine permutation distributions
## ----------------------------------------------------------

perm_results <- do.call(
  rbind,
  perm_results
)

TFCE_permMaxA <- perm_results[, "A"]
TFCE_permMaxB <- perm_results[, "B"]
TFCE_permMaxInt <- perm_results[, "Int"]

plan(sequential)

cat("Permutation testing completed.\n")

## ========================================================
## Step 4: TFCE-corrected significance
## ========================================================

cat("Step 4: Computing TFCE-corrected significance...\n")

alpha <- 0.05

maxTFCEA <- sort(c(TFCE_permMaxA, max(abs(TFCE_ObsA), na.rm = TRUE)))

maxTFCEcritA <- maxTFCEA[round(nPerm * (1 - alpha))]

MaskA <- abs(TFCE_ObsA) >= maxTFCEcritA

P_ValuesA <- matrix(NA,
                    nrow = nChan,
                    ncol = nTime,
                    dimnames = dimnames(TFCE_ObsA))

for (ch in seq_len(nChan)) {
  for (t in seq_len(nTime)) {
    P_ValuesA[ch, t] <-
      (sum(maxTFCEA >= abs(TFCE_ObsA[ch, t]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
      (nPerm + 1)
  }
}


maxTFCEB <- sort(c(TFCE_permMaxB, max(abs(TFCE_ObsB), na.rm = TRUE)))

maxTFCEcritB <- maxTFCEB[round(nPerm * (1 - alpha))]

MaskB <- abs(TFCE_ObsB) >= maxTFCEcritB

P_ValuesB <- matrix(NA,
                    nrow = nChan,
                    ncol = nTime,
                    dimnames = dimnames(TFCE_ObsB))

for (ch in seq_len(nChan)) {
  for (t in seq_len(nTime)) {
    P_ValuesB[ch, t] <-
      (sum(maxTFCEB >= abs(TFCE_ObsB[ch, t]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
      (nPerm + 1)
  }
}

maxTFCEInt <- sort(c(TFCE_permMaxInt, max(abs(TFCE_ObsInt), na.rm = TRUE)))

maxTFCEcritInt <- maxTFCEInt[round(nPerm * (1 - alpha))]

MaskInt <- abs(TFCE_ObsInt) >= maxTFCEcritInt

P_ValuesInt <- matrix(NA,
                    nrow = nChan,
                    ncol = nTime,
                    dimnames = dimnames(TFCE_ObsInt))

cat("TFCE-corrected significance completed.\n")

Results <- list(
  tObsA          = t_ObsA,
  TFCE_ObsA     = TFCE_ObsA,
  TFCE_NullA    = TFCE_permMaxA,
  maxTFCEcritA  = maxTFCEcritA,
  P_ValuesA     = P_ValuesA,
  MaskA         = MaskA,
  
  tObsB          = t_ObsB,
  TFCE_ObsB     = TFCE_ObsB,
  TFCE_NullB    = TFCE_permMaxB,
  maxTFCEcritB  = maxTFCEcritB,
  P_ValuesB     = P_ValuesB,
  MaskB         = MaskB,
  
  tObsInt = t_ObsInt,
  TFCE_ObsInt = TFCE_ObsInt,
  TFCE_NullInt = TFCE_permMaxInt,
  maxTFCEcritInt = maxTFCEcritInt,
  P_ValuesInt = P_ValuesInt,
  MaskInt = MaskInt,
  
  alpha        = alpha,
  nPerm        = nPerm,
  model        = "Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB",
  test         = "A and B",
  permutation  = "Synchronized permutation of subject-level 2 x 2 design labels"
)

cat("Results stored.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Save results
## ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists("../Results")) {
  dir.create("../Results")
}

save(Results, times, nChan, channels, file = "../Results/03_TFCE_between_subject_2x2_results.RData")

cat("\nTFCE 2 x 2 between-subject analysis completed.\n")
cat("Saved results: ../Results/03_TFCE_between_subject_2x2_results.RData\n")
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
## ==========================================================
## Plot significant corrected t-maps
## ==========================================================
rm(list =ls())
source("../R/plot_eeg_map.R")
load("../Results/03_TFCE_between_subject_2x2_results.RData")


mA <- Results$tObsA
mA[!Results$MaskA] <- 0
plot_eeg_map(mA, "TFCE-corrected Factor A Effect", times, nChan, channels)

mB <- Results$tObsB
mB[!Results$MaskB] <- 0
plot_eeg_map(mB, "TFCE-corrected Factor B Effect", times, nChan, channels)


mInt <- Results$tObsInt
mInt[!Results$MaskInt] <- 0
plot_eeg_map(mInt, "TFCE-corrected Factor A x Factor B Interaction", times, nChan, channels)

## ==========================================================
## Plot observed TFCE maps
## ==========================================================

plot_eeg_map(Results$TFCE_ObsA, "Observed TFCE Map: Factor A", times, nChan, channels)

plot_eeg_map(Results$TFCE_ObsB, "Observed TFCE Map: Factor B", times, nChan, channels)

plot_eeg_map(Results$TFCE_ObsInt, "Observed TFCE Map: Factor A x Factor B Interaction", times, nChan, channels)
```
